name: Shattrath City
shortDescription: Shattrath City, a named setting in the Karazhan research story.
body: The associated original environment art preserves these Outland’s pale draenei stone arches, open round terrace and luminous naaru crystal, with dusty ochre and broken terrain beyond the city. It remains an interpretive scene; no exact route, dungeon layout or surveyed coordinate is asserted. The Terrace of Light, where Haramad sends the recovered crystal to A’dal.
